signers.label: iMPlayer release key
signers.note: Pinned at the project owner's request. Measured by CI on the file served by https://implayer.tv/d on 2026-10-12 (package com.myiptvonline.implayer, version 4.1.6, versionCode 486). Single measurement from the same channel as the file.

trust.review: OWNER-APPROVED PIN. iMPlayer publishes no signing fingerprint and no release feed, so this certificate was taken from the vendor's own official download (https://implayer.tv/d, redirected to the vendor's storage bucket and served over HTTPS to a GitHub Actions runner on 2026-10-12: package com.myiptvonline.implayer, version 4.1.6, versionCode 486, minSdk 23, ~98 MB universal APK) and pinned at the project owner's explicit request so the app can install it with one press. It is a single measurement from the same channel as the file, not independently corroborated. From now on only an APK signed by this exact certificate is installed; any other signer fails closed with a signer-mismatch message and the guided route. Confirm it with the vendor or a second download before wider distribution. From some networks the official URL answers with a Cloudflare browser check, which the app reports and never bypasses. The Downloader code 82375 shown in the guided route was supplied by the project owner; this build does not vouch for what it resolves to.

steps: Install "Downloader" by AFTVnews from the Amazon Appstore.
Open Downloader and enter the code 82375.
Let the download finish, then choose Install when prompted.
Return to TV Essentials. iMPlayer will show as installed.

signers.label: SmartTube release key, issued 2025-11-27 (CN=Yurii L, O=SmartTube)
signers.note: Post-incident key. Measured with apksigner on official release assets 31.94s, 32.56s and 32.56 (stable and beta share it).

trust.review: The maintainer disclosed a compromised development environment and possible signing-key exposure and rotated to this certificate (created 2025-11-27). Pinned from the project's own GitHub release assets on 2026-10-12. The pre-rotation fingerprint was never published and its release assets are gone, so it cannot be listed under 'revoked'; it is rejected anyway because only the pinned certificate is trusted and lineage rotation is disabled. Confirm this fingerprint out-of-band before relying on it.
